data.title: Alimentation Couche-Tard: Core+More Strategy, Zabka Acquisition, and FY28 Earnings Power Support Buy Rating and C$101 Target Price
data.description:
Desjardins analyst Chris Li CFA has maintained their bullish stance on ATD stock, giving a Buy rating on October 19.

Chris Li CFA has given his Buy rating due to a combination of factors tied to Alimentation Couche-Tard’s resilient performance and strategic initiatives. Despite softer macro conditions pressuring convenience and fuel volumes, he expects solid execution of the Core+More strategy to sustain growth in higher-margin categories such as food, alternative nicotine and energy drinks, while fuel margins remain structurally elevated.

Looking ahead, he sees improving economic indicators supporting a return of U.S. merchandise same-store sales growth to the 2–3% range and views the upcoming Zabka acquisition as a meaningful earnings catalyst once synergies are detailed and realized. Together with disciplined capital allocation, ongoing share repurchases and a valuation based on robust FY28 earnings power, these drivers underpin his C$101 target price and support a continued Buy recommendation on ATD.
